description: Screenshot showing that Donald J. Trump retweeted a tweet by pseudonymous account LorenLaw88 (@Law88Loren), which claims Barack Obama 'knew everything' and participated in election interference, and tags several conservative media figures. A quoted tweet from pseudonymous account Anne E. Patriot (@MissILmom) praises Rep. Louie Gohmert and uses the QAnon hashtag #WWG1WGA. Red boxes highlight the 'Donald J. Trump Retweeted' banner and the #WWG1WGA hashtag — the relevance being that Trump retweeted a QAnon-hashtagged thread.

description: Mobile phone screenshot (taken 12:34 PM, per status bar) of a verified tweet by The Hill headlined 'Fifth Pentagon official announces resignation in a week', posted 11:13 AM on 19 Dec 2019. The attached stock photo shows a Pentagon press briefing: a woman in a magenta blazer and a Marine Corps general at podiums in front of the Pentagon seal — consistent with then-Pentagon chief spokesperson Dana White and Lt. Gen. Kenneth F. McKenzie Jr.
text: Tweet. The Hill @thehill. Fifth Pentagon official announces resignation in a week hill.cm/ZRMJgbE. THE PENTAGON WASHINGTON. 11:13 AM · 19 Dec 19 · SocialFlow. 38 Retweets 78 Likes. Tweet your reply.
flags: Identification of the two briefing-room figures as Dana White and Kenneth McKenzie is probable from appearance and context, not named in the image

description: Meme overlaying text on a photograph of a U.S. House Democratic press conference: Speaker Nancy Pelosi (yellow dress) at a lectern bearing the U.S. House seal, flanked by Reps. Adam Schiff, Elijah Cummings, and Jerry Nadler, with a Mueller-investigation results poster board beside them. The overlaid caption claims the impeachment effort is not about Trump's corruption but about hiding the Democrats' own corruption. Watermarked with a skull logo reading 'Freedom of Press'.

description: 'Spygate' meme: a dark blue-tinted photo montage of five faces — John Brennan, James Clapper, Barack Obama (center), Andrew McCabe, and James Comey — under the headline 'SPYGATE!'. The caption below claims Obama is the first president to leave office and collude with others to impede the next sitting president.
text: SPYGATE! Never has a president left office to collude with others to impede the next sitting president of the United States of America until Obama!
orgs: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

description: Meme built on a White House photograph of President Donald Trump standing behind White House social media director Dan Scavino, who is typing on an Apple MacBook; military flags with battle streamers and bookshelves are behind them. The overlaid caption jokes 'And when you finish typing... just sign it Q+', invoking the QAnon belief that Trump posts as 'Q+'.
text: AND WHEN YOU FINISH TYPING... JUST SIGN IT Q+
